reviewer_access: PNAS abstract; PMC full article HTML, Results and Discussion, Table 1, conclusion; local HTML archived
locators: Table 1; Results and Discussion paragraphs beginning There was only a slight decrease
evidence_summary: Table 1 reports 801 samples, 722 yielding lipids, and aquatic minima 73/156 and 256/566. The paper challenges predicted terrestrial functional change. The dossier preserves sampled-vessel denominators and imperfect plant detection, and does not adopt the paper’s stronger cultural-memory interpretation as established.
inference_assessment: Strong bounded residue association and a challenge to one simple rival; no identified psychological cause or household adoption rate. Underdetermined test status is appropriate.
repair: None required for the scoped statement. Preserve limitations in synthesis.
re_review_check: Any downstream summary must retain the sampled-vessel unit and distinguish challenging a rival from establishing the cause of expansion.
selection_reason: Risk: quantitative residue sample and rival discrimination; high-confidence mechanistic claim

reviewer_access: Author-uploaded article OCR on Academia; sections 2, 3.4, 4.2–4.3 and conclusion inspected
evidence_summary: The paper reports 52 selected beads, distinctive local compositional groups, regional matches and soda-lime glass at other Ile-Ife sites. It describes the selection and disturbed stratigraphy. Those constraints are present in the claim, episode and lineage fields.
inference_assessment: Evidence supports local composition and participation in exchange, without identifying every bead’s source or the direction of technical transmission.
repair: None required for the scoped statement.
re_review_check: Do not convert regional compositional matches into a documented carrier route or an estimate of population market share.
selection_reason: Risk: local manufacture and exchange inferred from compositional evidence

reviewer_access: UCL accepted PDF pp.2–4, and MAT-S13 author-uploaded text; PDF archived
locators: Accepted manuscript pp.2–4: Semi-finished glass, Laboratory analysis, Implications
evidence_summary: Three museum-store fragments recorded from Igbo Olokun contain heterogeneous partially reacted material, including residual quartz/feldspar and reaction phases. This is more direct evidence of primary melting than unique finished-glass chemistry. The dossier appropriately separates primary production from autonomous invention.
inference_assessment: Descriptive operation-level claim; independent-invention history remains unestablished. Shared investigators and site provenance are explicitly recorded.
re_review_check: Keep museum-store provenance visible and do not promote local production to proven independence from outside ideas.
selection_reason: Ordinary descriptive/positive control: incompletely reacted glass batch versus independent invention

evidence_summary: Paton’s text grants cultivation for five generations and reports builders’ expense. It does not explicitly say tax exemption. The claim correctly attributes a retrospective narrative; the lineage record recognises Boucharlat as interpretation of this same witness.

repair: None required for the exact translation claim. A Greek/legal interpretation audit remains a lead.
re_review_check: Retain the translation qualifier; do not turn the narrative into an observed policy experiment.

reviewer_access: Author-hosted published PDF §II.B, Figure I and footnote 8, pp.1410–1412; PDF archived
evidence_summary: The study states roughly 60% and explains that employment is imputed by multiplying within-occupation new-title shares by occupation employment. It lacks direct respondent counts by micro-title; footnote 8 describes validation and approximation. The dossier keeps these distinctions.
inference_assessment: Accurate description of a constructed estimate, not a direct worker count or identified technology-caused job share.

selection_reason: Risk: numerical estimate and imputation carried into future-role inference
Adaptive follow-up after industrial reviewer flagged IND-E14; inspect the previously unchecked co-support before adjudication.
reviewer_access: Fordham primary-source extract opened in full; targeted paragraphs beginning The principle, By the infirmity, In the infancy, It is in fact, and The effect inspected.
locators: Fordham excerpt, paragraphs beginning The principle of the factory system; By the infirmity; In the infancy of mechanical engineering; It is, in fact; The effect of substituting
evidence_summary: Ure explicitly advocates skill substitution and cheaper/tractable labour. The excerpt also reports female operation of throstle mills and a proprietor’s projected savings from self-acting mules. It contains more than abstract aspiration, but projected savings are not measured realised effects.
inference_assessment: K11 accurately reports advocacy. IND-E14’s broad observed-contribution label is not demonstrated solely by K10/K11 as currently worded; the source could support a narrower attributed factory-organisation claim. This is an unresolved provenance/scope issue, not confirmed historical disproof.
repair: For IND-E14, add a bounded claim covering Ure’s reported organisation and distinguish it from projected returns, or retain the broad link as hypothesis. The full historical mechanism needs further evidence.
re_review_check: Require exact proposition and stage: early invention motive, later reported workforce organisation, or actual recruitment effect. Do not dismiss contemporaneous descriptive assertions solely because the author is partisan.
